20logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

22# C++ layout names as printed by native ATen in the rejection message of 

23# ``aten::col_indices`` (ATen/SparseCsrTensorUtils.h dispatch macro). Only 

24# row-compressed layouts (CSR/BSR) carry a column-indices buffer; the mapping 

25# below covers every remaining standard layout so the mirrored message is 

26# byte-identical to the native one. 

27_NON_ROW_COMPRESSED_LAYOUT_NAMES = { 

28 torch.strided: "Strided", 

29 torch.sparse_coo: "Sparse", 

30 torch.sparse_csc: "SparseCsc", 

31 torch.sparse_bsc: "SparseBsc",

35def col_indices(self: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor: 

36 """Return the column indices of a sparse compressed tensor as a zero-copy view. 

37 

38 ``aten::col_indices(Tensor(a) self) -> Tensor(a)`` is a pure metadata 

39 accessor: the returned 1-D int64 tensor aliases the input tensor's internal 

40 ``col_indices`` buffer, so mutations written through the returned view are 

41 visible in the sparse tensor itself (and vice versa). No per-element 

42 computation is involved, therefore no Triton kernel is needed and 

43 ``pointwise_dynamic``/``triton.jit`` are intentionally omitted. 

44 

45 Layout coverage mirrors native ATen exactly (verified against native ATen 

46 on H20): only the row-compressed layouts CSR and BSR have a column-indices 

47 buffer. CSC, BSC, COO and strided inputs are rejected with the native 

48 ``RuntimeError`` ("col_indices expected sparse row compressed tensor 

49 layout but got <Layout>"). The guard raises that identical message itself 

50 because delegation cannot reach the native check for strided tensors: the 

51 general registrar also binds this implementation to the CUDA dispatch key, 

52 so re-dispatching a strided input would re-enter this override and 

53 recurse instead of surfacing the native error. 

54 

55 For the supported layouts the implementation delegates to the native 

56 backend kernel. Registering this override on the backend dispatch keys 

57 directly would make ``torch.ops.aten.col_indices`` re-enter the override 

58 for CSR/BSR inputs (RecursionError); registering on the autograd key and 

59 delegating inside ``torch._C._AutoDispatchBelowAutograd`` reaches the 

60 native ``SparseCsrCUDA`` kernel instead, preserving the zero-copy alias 

61 contract. 

62 """ 

63 logger.debug("GEMS COL_INDICES") 

64 if self.layout not in (torch.sparse_csr, torch.sparse_bsr): 

65 layout_name = _NON_ROW_COMPRESSED_LAYOUT_NAMES.get(self.layout) 

66 if layout_name is None: 

67 # Unknown layout: fall through to the native op, which reports it. 

68 with torch._C._AutoDispatchBelowAutograd(): 

69 return torch.ops.aten.col_indices.default(self) 

70 raise RuntimeError( 

71 "col_indices expected sparse row compressed tensor layout " 

72 f"but got {layout_name}" 

73 ) 

74 with torch._C._AutoDispatchBelowAutograd(): 

75 return torch.ops.aten.col_indices.default(self)
